name: co-VC Dimension / Log Size Ratio (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter has a universal affine-linear upper bound in terms of the other, even for finite binary classes.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For $\mathrm{ADDRESSING}_n$, $\mathrm{coVC}\geq2^{\lfloor\log_2n\rfloor}$ while the log size ratio is bounded by one.
parameter_2_larger_witness: For the full cube $2^{[n]}$, the log size ratio is $\log(2^n-1)/\log(n+1)=\Theta(n/\log n)$, while $\mathrm{coVC}=0$.
proof: The addressing and full-cube value calculations give gaps whose ratios diverge in the two opposite directions.
